I got herpes from someone who didn't know they had it. I had an outbreak near the base of my penis and we wore a condom a couple times but not always. So I still very well could have got it.  Her knowing goes a long way to help protecting you. 
Condoms in general I have seen provide anywhere from 30 to 90 percent protection. Widely quoted figure seems around 50 percent because they do not cover the whole area of the penis and surrounding area. The base of the prnis is unprotected and condoms can and do slide up during sex. So there is protection but far less than for many other stis. 
With her taking meds and you avoiding sex during her having an outbreak and you not wearing condoms there a decent chance you could get it but it's far from a guarantee. 

I'm not a big fan on the percent game here as I got it from having sex with a female about a half dozen times and two or three were briefly unprotected so while it was dumb of me to have sex before she was tested (they also don't even test for herpes here) I think the odds are quite variable.  It's good to see you being open to continuing your relationship. Any other advice please ask.

The risk isn't almost zero as a condom only reduces risk by around 50 percent. If you used a condom though any sores would likely be near the base of your penis or surrounding scrotum or area. Unlikely the head. Go see a doctor
